items.label: Vision
items.title: Wholeness
items.summary: Empowered lives rooted in awareness, authenticity, and compassion.
items.detail: We want people to live empowered lives — rooted in awareness of their needs, grounded in authenticity, and growing in compassion for one another.

items.label: Mission
items.title: Nurture & Grow
items.summary: Sharing Empowerment Therapy so practitioners and clients can thrive.
items.detail:
Our mission is to share Empowerment Therapy with practitioners and nurture their growth, so they can create the conditions for their clients to thrive.

We also equip managers with empowerment skills to foster workplaces rooted in safety, trust, and collaboration — where people can contribute their creativity and care in service of a shared purpose.

We do this in ways that are joyful, sustainable, and growthful — for those we serve, and for ourselves.

items.label: Connection
items.title: Beyond Roles
items.summary: Self-connection as the ground from which all meaningful work grows.
items.detail: Self-Connection — being in contact with our feelings, needs and natural compassion — is the ground from which we work. In that space, we endeavor to connect with others beyond roles. Our emphasis on connection is captured in the logo.

items.label: Values
items.title: Only Connect
items.summary: The prose and the passion, exalted together.
items.detail:
“Only connect. That was the whole of her sermon. Only connect the prose and the passion and both will be exalted, and human love will be seen at its height. Live in fragments no longer. Only connect…”

— E. M. Forster
